task: Ground factual claims for runtime data boundary steering.
output_summary: The platform now records a customer-hidden source boundary and separates runtime data, logs, cache, user workspace, and agent workspace planes for installed desktop products.

evidence.reliability: Official Tauri documentation for desktop distribution and packaging boundaries.
Official Tauri documentation for frontendDist, bundle resources, filesystem permissions, and app data/cache/log directory classes.
Official Apple and Microsoft documentation for app containers and app data storage concepts.
Primary registry added by this work and validated by check-config-contract plus readiness tests.
Human-readable product and architecture boundary documents updated in the same change set.
Validation record listing successful JSON, config, memory bootstrap, npm, Cargo, Tauri, codesign, hdiutil, and diff checks.

claims.statement: Installed customers should use the app, selected workspaces, and runtime data/log/export surfaces without seeing the platform source tree as a product feature.
verification_steps: Ran platform-desktop-app readiness test for source-hidden tokens.

claims.statement: The registry defines separate runtime planes for app bundle, user workspace, platform data store, log store, agent workspace, and cache store.
verification_steps: Ran readiness token checks for platform_data_store, log_store, and agent_workspace.

claims.statement: The local Rust/Tauri build path still passes after the governance change.

uncertainty_notes: Official Tauri, Apple, or Microsoft docs may change after 2026-06-03.
Actual runtime storage adapter implementation remains a future slice.
limitation_notes: Public macOS distribution readiness is not claimed because Developer ID signing, notarization, and stapling were not performed.
No support bundle exporter or installer payload scanner was implemented in this slice.
